independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG7 implementation, test, register row, ADR, handover text, release tool or delivery record in the reviewed candidate. I raised F-DG7-923 in round 6. Its repair (AN-P7I text, DO-D10 application) was written by the transformation-analyst and the devops-engineer, so I verify it as a non-author. I also verify F-DG7-942 (code-security-reviewer) and F-DG7-972 (qa-verifier), which describe the same gap. At the start I checked the assignment's sha256 (41c129cd...3540b, matching). At the start HEAD was the freeze commit 9bb110e43. It differs from the source commit 7579382c5 only by the round-7 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json, none of which are in the manifest. The candidate ID recomputes to sha256:0d71d445... at HEAD, at --ref 7579382c5 and in a fresh clone at 7579382c5, so I proceeded. I formed this verdict without reading any other reviewer's round-7 record. I grant no business, Finance, IT or production approval, and no product gate G1-G6. Product G6 never implies DG7.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the assignment hash. Check HEAD and what the freeze commit changes relative to the source commit. Recompute the candidate at the working tree and at --ref of the source commit, and diff it against the frozen manifest. Repeat in a fresh disposable clone checked out at the source commit. The diff is repeated at the end (DOM-R7-13).
checks_run.command: sha256sum <assignment>; git rev-parse HEAD; git diff --stat 7579382c5 HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 --ref 7579382c59e1791321d4856ac1cb2eb2cfb4edc7; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 --diff docs/delivery/candidates/DG7/0d71d4456adaac94.manifest.json; git clone <repo> $TMPDIR/review-dom7 && git checkout 7579382c5 && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7
checks_run.environment: Repository /home/user/My-owns, HEAD 9bb110e43 (freeze commit) at the start; disposable clone at 7579382c5 under $TMPDIR; Node 24.21.0 first on PATH; agent sandbox
checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:0d71d445...2272 over 3158 files everywhere; diff matches with no added, removed or changed files; the freeze commit touches only files outside the manifest
checks_run.actual: Assignment sha256 41c129cd...3540b, as given. HEAD 9bb110e43 adds only the 3 round-7 assignments and the manifest, and edits stages.json (5 files). Working tree, --ref 7579382c5 and the clone each give sha256:0d71d4456adaac949e2c9af4c975f4b9976a166872195f496d5aa75fe8ed2272 with 3158 files. --diff gives matches true with empty lists. Every command exited 0.

checks_run.procedure: Verify F-DG7-923/942/972. Read the D-278 text on every surface ADR-0064 Amendment 5 A5.6 names (known-limitations.md, the release notes, deployment.md's drill section) and on both Arabic summaries, the release-notes Arabic section and the handover README. checks_run.command: grep -n -B2 -A12 D-278 docs/handover/{known-limitations,deployment,release-notes}.md docs/handover/*.ar-summary.md; sed -n 1318,1560p ADR-0064; grep -n 'job_schedule|clock_timestamp' deploy/scripts/transfer-drill.sh; grep -n read_only deploy/scripts/drill/schedule-explained.mjs; cat tools/release/release-notes-disclosures.json

checks_run.expected: Each surface states (1) that a scheduled job running in the drill is explained only as A5.2 says and is listed in the report, (2) that a scheduled handler writing business rows in the window still makes D9 fail, which is not a data defect, and (3) that the recovery is to re-run the drill, never to pause a schedule. Each also states the open residuals 3 and 4 accurately, in English and in provisional Arabic.
checks_run.actual: known-limitations.md §6 has the row 'ADR-0064 Amendment 5 (D-278)'. It states all three statements and accurate A5.2 conditions: an added execution with no initiating user and a schedule trigger, a trigger_key naming an enabled job_schedule row, the slot of that row's cron and timezone inside the D7-D9 window on the target database's clock, created inside the window with the worker's audit event, at most one per slot, plus its action results and audit events. It names the report fields (schedule-explained-d9.json; D9 recheck/scheduleExplained/scheduleWindow). Its examples (an escalated approval; kpi.reporting_period_open opening a period) match A5.7 residuals 1-2. It gives residual 3 (engine ticks not covered, not decided) and residual 4 (pg-boss 11.0.0 defaults, an ADR-0068 upgrade item), and adds D-278 to Sources. deployment.md: the drill paragraph gives the exact window W0-60 s (exclusive) to W1 on the target clock and notes that reconcile-d9.json keeps the real result. A new paragraph covers residuals 3-4 and links to known-limitations#adr-residuals; the anchor exists (§6). release-notes.md has the new section 'Known limitations disclosed in this release' with five bullets covering statements 1-3 and residuals 3-4, plus a Details link. Its Arabic section 'قيود معروفة يفصح عنها هذا الإصدار' carries the H.3 provisional lines and the same five points. known-limitations.ar-summary item 7 and deployment.ar-summary's drill paragraph carry all three statements and residual 3. known-limitations.ar-summary also carries residual 4; deployment.ar-summary leaves it out, which is acceptable for a summary because its English source and known-limitations carry it. The README index line names the new release-notes section and its input file. Consistency with the code: transfer-drill.sh reads W0/W1 with clock_timestamp() on T and states that job_schedule is never written, and schedule-explained.mjs uses default_transaction_read_only=on. No surface claims more than A5.2 allows, and none claims an approval. All three findings are resolved on this candidate.

checks_run.procedure: Read the two secret-allowlist.json entries D-280 added. Recover, by hashing every substring of the named line, the exact value each valueSha256 covers, and confirm it is a regex fragment, not a credential, and that each entry is scoped to history only.
checks_run.command: git diff 830d7edfd 7579382c5 -- tools/release/secret-allowlist.json; node $TMPDIR/al.mjs (substring hash search on docs/delivery/reviews/DG7/round-6/qa-verifier.json l.442 and docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/qa/round-6/98-evidence-hygiene.log l.4)
checks_run.expected: Each hash covers only part of a grep pattern; scopes = [history]
checks_run.actual: Entry S3 ec2276aa... covers '|password=...|BEGIN' from the round-6 QA record's command line (grep -E 'client_secret=|password=...|BEGIN ... PRIVATE|...'). checks_run.procedure: Judge D-280's ADR-0071 §5.1 note. Compare ADR-0071 §5 (the generator 'reads nothing else'; the listed sections) with the new behaviour of release-notes.mjs and its tests.
checks_run.command: sed -n 172,205p docs/architecture/adr/ADR-0071-...md; grep D-280 docs/delivery/decisions.md; read tools/release/release-notes-disclosures.json and the DO-D10 handback
checks_run.expected: Any departure from ADR-0071 is recorded, and the ADR's intent holds: deterministic output from named, checked-in inputs, with no business claim
checks_run.actual: ADR-0071 §5.1 says the generator reads the register, the dependency list and the provisional Arabic files and 'reads nothing else'. §5.2 lists the sections without a known-limitations section. The generator now also reads tools/release/release-notes-disclosures.json, a checked-in file in its own directory with an optional --disclosures override, and prints a new section. D-280 records this explicitly and accepts it as within ADR-0071's intent, so it is a recorded decision, not undisclosed drift. I agree. The input is named, versioned (format mth-release-notes-disclosures/1), strictly validated (unknown keys, one-line strings, relative docs/handover .md links only), and never read from docs/delivery/**. Output stays deterministic: --check reproduces byte-for-byte and the T-I11 no-clock test passes. The ADR's §5.2 section list is now incomplete; the decision log, not an ADR amendment, is the place that records this. I note it as an observation only: it has no behavioural effect and the governance record exists.

After scoping the entries to history, prefreeze-r7b re-ran four checks: secret-payload PASS (3158 files), secret-history PASS, release-tool-tests 469 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped (T-A11 BLOCKED no runtime tree, T-A3 no bsdtar) and prettier, all exit 0. The integration suite ran in prefreeze-r7 (exit 0, 3377 s); live CI was not run (D-058). D-274 Q19 extension: 23 rows carry 'completes-after-gate:'. DLV-011, DLV-012, DLV-024 and DLV-030 still rest on the D-270 protocol hits and the A27 K11 partial, honestly stated in the register, About, the release notes and known-limitations. I do not treat those clauses as met. I do not reject the extension: those clauses can only complete with the gate itself, it changes no product behaviour, and acceptance is the release-auditor's decision under D-274. D-278 is judged in DOM-R7-04 and D-280 in DOM-R7-06 and DOM-R7-11. ADR-0065 Amendment 1 (automation_rule not carried) is disclosed in known-limitations and its Arabic summary item 6. D-267 (the container half and the Keycloak e2e run once on the orchestrator's host) shows on About as keycloak-e2e 'Not verified'. I did not re-run it and I do not mark it PASS myself. Environmental residuals, each PASS on the offline/config surface: live registry (REQ-DLV-042 AC-1, D-057); live CI (REQ-DLV-025 A24, D-058); Keycloak and an enterprise IdP (D-049; bundled test issuer only, SAML documented, not run); no real Mobily system, mail, messaging or AI provider (test adapters and the shipped disabled configuration); REQ-S20-029/030 as provisional single-host engineering targets, not verified Mobily capacity. Playbook semantics (RAG from trajectory, delivery/adoption/validated value/closure separate, forecast never validated value, Finance validation, no double counting, gates tied to evidence snapshots) were judged in earlier rounds; this round's diff touches none of them. No record or handover text claims a business, Finance, IT or production approval, official PMI status or a verified Mobily brand, and product G6 is never equated with DG7.

summary: PASS on sha256:0d71d445 (source 7579382c5). F-DG7-923, F-DG7-942 and F-DG7-972 are verified fixed (CLOSED_VERIFIED in my verifications sidecar). The D-278 rule, its three required statements and residuals 3-4 are now in known-limitations.md, deployment.md, the generated release notes (English and provisional Arabic) and both Arabic summaries, and they match ADR-0064 A5.2/A5.7 and the drill code. The generated texts reproduce with --check. The two new allow-list entries cover only regex fragments and apply to history only. D-280's ADR-0071 note is acceptable as a recorded decision. Product, drill and register are byte-identical to round 6. Drill tests 70/70; About and register end-to-end tests 4/4 in English and Arabic; release-tool suite 468/1/2, where the one failure (T-A5) is a read-only pnpm store in my sandbox and passes 1/1 with a writable store copy. No new findings.
